The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `5432` (see `PostgreSqlBuilder.PostgreSqlPort`)
- Environment variable: `POSTGRES_DB=postgres` (see `PostgreSqlBuilder.WithDatabase(string)`)
- Environment variable: `POSTGRES_USER=postgres` (see `PostgreSqlBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres` (see `PostgreSqlBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Command: `-c fsync=off -c full_page_writes=off -c synchronous_commit=off`
- Wait strategy: Waits until `pg_isready` reports that the database accepts connections.
